title: Gentle Dot · native installer directions
brief: Direction 01 uses top-level Windows, macOS and Linux preview cards with only the selected OS requirements visible. Directions 02 and 03 remain the original macOS/Linux trust-first and compact-update alternatives. Every state is simulated; no package, network, OS or application operations occur.

artboards.title: Choose your system · a clearer setup
artboards.tradeoff: Prominent OS cards reveal one platform at a time and keep the check-to-approval flow compact; technical, runtime and recovery details require disclosure.

artboards.title: Trust first · evidence before approval
artboards.tradeoff: An open verification ledger beside a package receipt makes trust boundaries inspectable; increases reading effort before the next action.

artboards.title: Compact · a deliberate update pause
artboards.tradeoff: A centered update sheet and ordered handoff minimize interruption for returning users; deeper preservation and OS-permission details are collapsed.
